question: Which temporal obligations must a correct pending-to-ready implementation preserve?
candidate_obligations: A pending foreground preparation schedules another check and completes exactly once only after ready.
Closing the foreground dialog invalidates scheduled and in-flight work.
A reopened foreground dialog accepts only responses from its new generation.
Closing the background panel always cancels its workspace-owned export.
The background export continues after its panel closes unless its ownership migration is authorized.
